question: Which month in 2017 had the largest absolute difference between cumulative bike usage minutes for customers and subscribers?	Which month (in number) in 2017 had the largest absolute difference between cumulative bike usage minutes (in thousands) for customers and subscribers, based on the trip end dates in the San Francisco bikeshare data?
sql:
WITH all_months AS (
  SELECT GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 12) AS months
),
month_list AS (
  SELECT month FROM all_months, UNNEST(months) AS month
),
monthly_minutes AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE(end_date)) AS month,
    subscriber_type,
    SUM(duration_sec) / 60.0 AS total_minutes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips`
  WHERE DATE(end_date) >= '2017-01-01' AND DATE(end_date) < '2018-01-01'
    AND subscriber_type IN ('Customer', 'Subscriber')
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE(end_date)), subscriber_type
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT 
    month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Customer' THEN total_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS customer_minutes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Subscriber' THEN total_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS subscriber_minutes
  FROM monthly_minutes
  GROUP BY month
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT 
    ml.month,
    SUM(COALESCE(p.customer_minutes, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ml.month) AS cum_customer,
    SUM(COALESCE(p.subscriber_minutes, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ml.month) AS cum_subscriber,
    ABS(SUM(COALESCE(p.customer_minutes, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ml.month) - SUM(COALESCE(p.subscriber_minutes, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ml.month)) / 1000.0 AS cum_abs_diff_thousands
  FROM month_list ml
  LEFT JOIN pivoted p ON ml.month = p.month
)
SELECT 
  month,
  cum_customer,
  cum_subscriber,
  cum_abs_diff_thousands
FROM cumulative
ORDER BY month
